analysis: Examined all units. (1) ModelPrefetchCoordinator.swift: onVerified is replaced by a publish hook returning an optional refusal string. The legacy init wraps onVerified and returns nil, so behavior is preserved. A refusal now yields .failed instead of .verified via finishPublished (head lines 295, 318, 327-330). Task-ID ownership, cancellation and shutdown guards in finish() are unchanged. A refused build is reported as failed rather than falsely verified, which is fail-safe. The remaining integration question is whether the host's publish closure (not in this batch) enforces storage, model-count and disk-reserve limits and consent before adding a build to the Autopilot set. Publishing only adds to the Autopilot set, and the new CLI text says downloads never load a model. Check that the Autopilot set cannot widen coordinator-advertised models or serving authorization (TB-011, T-052, T-053), and that weight-hash verification (T-012, T-027) still gates the verified build. (2) ProviderLoopConfig.swift: adds an optional autopilotPendingCandidates field, a value type with no behavior. (3) AutopilotDownloadCommands.swift (new): CLI subcommands that write [backend.autopilot_downloads] through withMutableConfig under the config lock. They do not touch consent. Limits are validated as at least 1 and parsed as UInt64. Prompt input comes from the local user, who is the same trust domain as the config. No network, secret or attestation surface is involved. Default-on downloads once enrolled is a behavior and disclosure change. The updated help text discloses it and offers a disable command. The actual downloader, ledger and disk guard are outside this batch, and any check that downloaded catalog models are integrity-verified, plus the T-016 disk-fill/DoS risk, depends on them. (4) AutopilotStatusCommand.swift: read-only display of local config, the ledger and the live snapshot, with no sensitive data exposed. Next pass should review the AutopilotDownloadLedger, the disk guard and the publish-closure implementation in ProviderLoop.
